To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Chow motive of moduli of stable vector bundles on a smooth projective algebraic curve lies in the category spanned by the motive of this curve, and that the class of this Chow motive is computable.

the motive of the moduli space of stable vector bundles of fixed rank and degree on a smooth projective algebraic curve lies in the category of motives generated by the curve and its class can be computed in terms of the class of the curve and its Hodge polynomial.
